notes.title: "Solvable" mode in update 1.4.0!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]A "solvable" mode has been added to the classic minesweeper
[*]Added custom pixel cursor. You can disable it in options -> display
[*]Fixed a problem with display options at non-standard resolution
[/list]

notes.title: The "Tower of Power" is out! Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
You have to climb the tower floor by floor!
There is a small story and an endless mode.
The tower uses many features of the game:
[list]
[*]Items
[*]Pets
[*]Puzzles add-on
[/list]
There are new game modes:
[list]
[*]Key search
[*]Competition with the boss
[/list]
You can upgrade your tower to reach new heights!
In addition, 8 new achievements have been added.

notes.title: The Puzzles add-on is out! Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
The Puzzles add-on is out!
[list]
[*]42 unique puzzle images
[*]714 levels
[*]Each level is shaped like a puzzle piece
[*]Two game modes: normal and hardcore. In hardcore, puzzles consist of 16 parts, so it's much more interesting to assemble them
[*]6 new achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Update with the wishes of the players! Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In the options, you can now turn off the fullscreen mode and select the resolution for the windowed mode
[*] In the control settings, you can disable the movement of the field with the mouse
[*] The hotkey for opening a shop has changed to "E"
[*] You can now move the minefield with the arrow keys and WASD. The directions of movement can be inverted in the control settings
[*] The "shop" and "quests" buttons on the minefield have become larger
[*] Fixed an issue with some achievements
[/list]
